name: University of Queensland
summary: Brisbane's St Lucia campus; three-year science and commerce degrees and four-year engineering, with intakes in February and July.

ib.text: Each program lists an IB score from last year's lowest offer: Science 30.25, Commerce 31, Engineering 32. Prerequisites are Queensland subjects (English, Maths Methods, Chemistry or Physics) with IB equivalents.

apply.via: Direct to UQ (QTAC is for Australian schooling)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.about: A three-year science degree with 16 extended majors, 26 majors and 35 minors; you can mix science and non-science courses in first year and combine it with 13 other programs.
programmes.ib: IB 30.25 was the lowest adjusted offer for Semester 1, 2026. Prerequisites are Queensland subjects; ask UQ which IB courses count.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB score; the published score is last year's lowest adjusted offer and does not guarantee entry. Updated each April.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Science: 16 extended majors, 26 majors and 35 minors, one of the broadest selections of science disciplines

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.about: A four-year engineering degree with a flexible first year, then 6 core specialisations and 12 majors; programs can be combined with Science, Computer Science, Design, Arts and others.
programmes.ib: IB 32 was the lowest adjusted offer for Semester 1, 2026. Prerequisites: English, Maths Methods and one of Chemistry or Physics (Queensland subjects).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB score; the published score is last year's lowest adjusted offer and does not guarantee entry. Updated each April.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours): the largest number of engineering study options in Queensland

faculties.name: Business, Economics and Law
faculties.line: Commerce: IB 31 last year; Business Management 26.75. Both start in February or July.

faculties.name: Engineering, Architecture and Information Technology
faculties.line: Engineering (Honours): IB 32 last year; English, Maths Methods and Chemistry or Physics are prerequisites.

faculties.name: Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences
faculties.line: International Studies: IB 31 last year; the program starts in February only.

faculties.name: Science
faculties.line: Bachelor of Science: IB 30.25 last year; starts in February or July.

notes: IB students outside Australia apply directly to UQ; QTAC is for students completing Australian Year 12 or an IB in Australia.
UQ accepts applications up to two years ahead and recommends applying early, because some programs have limited places and your visa takes time.
Published entry scores are last year's lowest adjusted offers and are updated each April; meeting one does not guarantee a place.
